title: Coinbase Pushes Gold And Silver Trading Toward Always-On Markets
summary: TL;DR Coinbase has already launched gold and silver perpetual futures for eligible non-US traders. This expansion represents a key step in the company's strategy to bring traditional precious metals trading into continuous, crypto-style derivatives markets.
